entities.name: PMID:25091178
observations: Retrospective sequential cohort (n=107): day-1 PTH/calcium-guided management was associated with median stay of 1 day versus 4 days under serial calcium/symptom monitoring (p<0.0001); fewer hypocalcemic symptoms and no IV calcium use in the PTH-guided group.

entities.name: PMID:18573120
observations: Cohort protocol study: 4-hour iPTH-guided management yielded mean stay 1.64 versus 2.20 days (p<0.05); over half of 50 protocol patients discharged on postoperative day 1, with no readmissions reported.

entities.name: PMID:27779965
observations: Retrospective study (n=697): 1-hour PTH protocol was associated with lower overnight observation (53.7% vs 97.4%) and shorter stay (0.89 vs 1.98 days); symptomatic hypocalcemia rates were similar (15.9% vs 16.8%).

entities.name: PMID:23896242
observations: Retrospective application of a PTH risk algorithm suggested potential cost and same-day-discharge benefits, but did not prospectively test whether a PTH pathway shortened length of stay.
